scene_description: Three food packages stacked on a gray table: a clear-lidded food container at the bottom, wrapped lemon loaf in the middle, and blue chip bag on top.

targets.name: food container
targets.description: Tan clear-lidded container at the bottom of the stack, beneath the lemon loaf and blue chip bag.
targets.clearance_notes: Lower side faces are exposed, but the loaded lid cannot be accessed independently without disturbing the upper packages. The target is set back from the front accessible edge; bringing it forward could reduce the approach distance even though some surfaces are exposed.

candidate_improvements.description: Lift the blue bag off the stack and place it roughly 25 cm to the left on clear tabletop.
Lift the lemon loaf package off the container and place it roughly 20 cm to the right on clear tabletop.
After removing the blue bag and lemon loaf, move the food container approximately 15 cm toward the front edge of the table, into a clear position while keeping the entire object supported.

targets.other_notes: Front means the foreground edge in images/01.jpg.

targets.name: blue chip bag
targets.description: Blue bag with the nutrition panel facing upward, forming the top of the food stack.
targets.clearance_notes: Upper face and outer edges are exposed, with no object resting above it. The target is set back from the front accessible edge; bringing it forward could reduce the approach distance even though some surfaces are exposed.

candidate_improvements.description: Lift the bag off the stack and place it separately nearer the front. Move the blue chip bag approximately 15 cm toward the front edge of the table, into a clear position while keeping the entire object supported.

targets.name: lemon loaf
targets.description: Clear-wrapped lemon loaf with a black label, sandwiched between the blue bag and the food container lid.
targets.clearance_notes: Part of the wrapper is visible from the sides, but the bag covers much of the top. The target is set back from the front accessible edge; bringing it forward could reduce the approach distance even though some surfaces are exposed.

candidate_improvements.description: Lift the blue bag off the stack and place it roughly 25 cm to the left on clear tabletop.

After removing the blue bag, lift the loaf off the container and move the lemon loaf approximately 15 cm toward the front edge of the table, into a clear position while keeping the entire object supported.

source: Staged permutation of S0020 and S0024, using the same objects in a different arrangement.
